from build123d import *

# Overall envelope
width = 80.0        # X
depth = 20.3        # Y
height = 26.7       # Z

# Profile
stem_width = 30.0   # X width of the lower stem
flange_thickness = 2.0
stem_depth = depth - flange_thickness  # 18.3

# Hole callout: 1x Ø5.3 THRU / Ø13.2 (counterbore)
hole_dia = 5.3
cbore_dia = 13.2
cbore_depth = 10.7

# Build the stepped profile (XZ plane extruded along Y)
base = Box(stem_width, depth, height)
flange = Pos(0, depth/2 - flange_thickness/2, 0) * Box(width, flange_thickness, height)
solid_body = base + flange

# Counterbore hole on the front face (Y = -depth/2), axis along Y
hole_x = 0
hole_z = 0
shaft = Pos(hole_x, 0, hole_z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_dia/2, depth + 10)
cbore = Pos(hole_x, -depth/2 + cbore_depth/2, hole_z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(cbore_dia/2, cbore_depth)

from build123d import *

# ---- Overall dimensions ----
overall_width = 53.2
overall_height = 80.0
thickness = 7.7

# ---- Main body ----
body_width = 31.0
body_height = 63.2

# ---- Tab / boss ----
boss_radius = 5.55          # ø11.1
boss_center_x = 47.65       # from left edge
boss_center_y = 74.45       # from bottom edge

# ---- Holes ----
hole_radius = 12.2          # ⌀24.4
hole_center_x = 15.5
hole_y1 = 15.5
hole_y2 = 48.6

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (body_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (body_width, body_height - 16.8))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, body_height))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# Add round boss at the tab tip
solid_body = solid_body + Pos(boss_center_x, boss_center_y, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(boss_radius, thickness)

# Cut the two through holes
for hy in (hole_y1, hole_y2):
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(hole_center_x, hy, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_radius, thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "plate_with_boss_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

base_radius = 40.0
base_height = 26.0
hex_across_flats = 25.15
hex_height = 32.1

base = Pos(0, 0, base_height / 2) * Cylinder(base_radius, base_height)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_height)) as s:
        RegularPolygon(hex_across_flats, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_height)
hex_boss = p.part

part = base + hex_boss
part.name = "base_with_hex_boss"
export_step(part, "output.step")
